payload.function_structure:
OVERALL FUNCTION: supply the worker with what it needs to work correctly, and decide mechanically what can be decided.

Solution-neutral throughout - no tool named, because M4 chooses the tools.

F-GROUP 1: ACQUIRE MATERIAL
- F1 locate material (find where something is, by pattern, by shape of name, or by absence)
- F2 deliver material in portions (hand over a requested part, and say how much remains)
- F3 reach material outside the immediate workspace (address a source that is not underfoot)
- F4 reach material that exists only in the record (retrieve what no workspace holds)
- F5 bound the retrieval (limit time, quantity and width, so acquiring never overwhelms)
- F6 contain the reach (keep an addressed source addressable and nothing beyond it)

F-GROUP 2: ANSWER HONESTLY
- F7 refuse a malformed request (decline rather than infer a missing part)
- F8 report absence (say that nothing matched)
- F9 report incompleteness (say what was not delivered, never imply wholeness)

F-GROUP 3: ALTER MATERIAL
- F10 alter many places as one act (change several sites indivisibly)
- F11 guard each alteration (verify each site is what the caller believed)
- F12 undo the whole on any failure (leave no partial state)
- F13 keep alteration to one path (ensure no other route alters material unrecorded)

F-GROUP 4: SUPPLY THE RULES
- F14 select the rules that bind this work (choose by declared applicability)
- F15 resolve a rule to its content (deliver the rule itself, not a pointer to it)
- F16 report the weight of what was supplied (make the volume visible)

F-GROUP 5: DECIDE MECHANICALLY
- F17 derive a fact from the record (compute something checkable without judgement)
- F18 compare a fact against what is claimed (decide pass or fail)
- F19 hand back what cannot be decided (defer to judgement without stopping)
- F20 state the fact behind a refusal (make a mechanical no arguable)
- F21 distinguish decided from claimed (mark which is which, durably)

F-GROUP 6: PRESERVE THE RECORD
- F22 name the record immutably (identify it by something nobody can rename away)
- F23 name the record readably (identify it by something a person can type)
- F24 remove competing names (ensure one name means one thing)
- F25 carry the names outward (ensure the record travels when the work does)

F-GROUP 7: HOLD LOCAL SETTINGS
- F26 present settings (show what is configured, without exposing what must stay secret)
- F27 accept and validate settings (take a change and say whether it is usable)

F-GROUP 8: ACCOUNT FOR ACCESS
- F28 record what was consulted (attribute by name, so a later reader knows the source)

TWO SEPARATIONS ARE DELIBERATE AND LOAD-BEARING: F22 apart from F23 (an immutable name and a readable name are different jobs - conflating them is exactly today's defect, where a deletable label is the only pointer); and F18 apart from F19 (deciding and deferring must be distinct outcomes, or 'cannot decide' silently becomes 'fail' and parks a run).
payload.coverage:
EVERY REQUIREMENT MAPS, and every use-case step is covered. No empty row in either direction.

REQUIREMENT -> FUNCTION: R1->F2. R2->F2,F9. R3->F1. R4->F1. R5->F4. R6->F3,F4. R7->F3,F6. R8->F7. R9->F28. R10->F8. R11->F10. R12->F11,F12. R13->F13. R14->F14,F15. R15->F16. R16->F17,F18. R17->F18,F19. R18->F17. R19->F20. R20->F21. R21->F14 (a state's declared need for a scan is itself a rule that must be selected and honoured). R22->F22. R23->F23. R24->F24. R25->F25. R26->F26. R27->F27. R28->F5. R29->F6. D1->F1,F2,F3,F4 exercised together.

USE-CASE STEP -> FUNCTION: UC-A 1->F14,F15,F16; 2->(agent judgement, no system function - correctly, since choosing WHICH source to consult is not the system's job); 3->F1,F2,F3; 4->F1,F2; 5->(agent); 6->F28. UC-A ext 3a->F2,F9; 3b->F3,F6; 3c->F4; 4a->F8; 4b->F7; 6a->F28.
UC-B 1->F1; 2->F10,F11; 3->F10,F12; 4->F28. ext 2a->F12; 2b->F11; 3a->(no function - it is a design property, that the lane be faster; it belongs to the quality requirement, not to a function).
UC-C 1->(machine state); 2->F17; 3->F18,F21; 4->(agent); 5->(adjudication, out of scope); 6->F21. ext 2a->F19; 3a->F20; 3b->(reportable by the agent, not a system function); 5a->F19.
UC-D 1->(close); 2->F22; 3->F23,F25; 4->F24; 5->F4. ext 2a->F22; 3a->(owner act, deliberately outside); 5a->F24.

NO FUNCTION IS ORPHANED: every one of F1-F28 is required by at least one requirement.

TWO HOLES FOUND AND NAMED rather than papered over - both are places where a use-case step maps to NO system function, and both are correct: UC-A step 2 (deciding which source to consult is the agent's judgement, and a system that chose for it would be doing something this iteration explicitly does not do), and UC-B ext 3a (the lane being faster than a script is a quality property, carried by R15's sibling reasoning rather than by a function). Recording them because an unmapped step normally signals a missing function, and here it signals a correct boundary.
